entries.label: M-01
entries.title: Unconfigured non-18-decimal token treated as 18-dec 1:1 (fail-open default) — one forgotten setTokenConfig lets any NFT holder drain that strategy's full yield for ~0 payment, or bricks all claims
entries.triageNote: Acknowledged. Won't fix the current contract as it is already deployed, but will ensure all tokens are properly configured (setTokenConfig). Planning a new version of SYA using different reward mechanics that likely no longer rely on decimal-place logic.

entries.description: Fail-open unconfigured-token default: _normalizeAmount/_denormalizeAmount treat a token with the default (decimals==0, rate==0) as 18-dec 1:1; addYieldStrategy/setRewardToken never require a TokenConfig. A forgotten setTokenConfig on a <18-dec (e.g. 6-dec USDC/USDT) strategy token lets any NFT holder skim 100% of its yield while actualPayment floors to 0 (permissionless, repeatable); the symmetric reward-token misconfig bricks all yielding claims. Non-obvious owner footgun (Law 3) enabling a Law-1 exploit. Machine-verified (invariant property-4 PoC + halmos SYMBOLIC-001/002).
crossLinks: L-01 (0da2e7cf...713d): MECHANISM weaponized ~1e12x by this finding; L-01 stays dust-only Low, do not re-escalate.
PARK-08 folds into this root cause (a 'configured' flag resolves both).
entries.note: SEVERITY: Top-of-band Medium. PLAUSIBLE-HIGH DISSENT RECORDED for the severity-auditor — a reasonable judge could rate this Plausible-High on the 'insecure-by-default for the dominant 6-dec token type + direct 100% theft' reading. Classifier verdict Medium on strict C4 external-requirement text (owner config omission the attacker cannot control/induce) + scanner consensus + loss-of-yield (in-motion) cap + phoenix CLASS-001 precedent. Remediation mandatory either way. Distinct from suppressed malicious-owner C-01 (needs no malice). Full dissent in the finding JSON severityDispute.dissentForAuditor. SUBMISSION: report-validation VALID + PoC poc-validation PASS; finding record status -> submitted (run stable-yield-accumulator-12). Ledger open/triage status intentionally unchanged (no per-entry workflow-status field); reportPath now points at the submission .md.

entries.label: L-04
entries.title: setNudgeSplit(>0) does not require nudge != address(0) — enabling the split before wiring the recipient bricks every yielding claim (NudgeNotConfigured)
entries.reconciliation: Re-proven STILL-LIVE at HEAD 0fef726 in REGRESSION run stable-yield-accumulator-13: in-scope contract src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol blob byte-identical to run-12 baseline 71abe3e (blob d9984cfe). Pure-reasoning finding; STILL-LIVE by byte-identity. Status unchanged.
entries.description: Write-side enforcement gap: setNudgeSplit only checks _split>100, never nudge!=address(0); the coupling invariant is enforced only on the read side (claim() L506 NudgeNotConfigured). Enabling the split before wiring the recipient (natural config order), or clearing the address while a split is active, bricks every yielding claim atomically (no NFT burned) until the owner fixes it. Owner-recoverable availability footgun; no value loss. The L506 revert is FAITHFUL/documented (story-023).
crossLinks: story-023: L506 read-side revert is intended; gap is the missing write-side guard.

entries.label: L-05
entries.title: claim/preview gas scales with (strategies x authorized-clients); above the discount-vs-gas threshold permissionless consolidation stalls (owner/OOS-bounded, NOT a permissionless DoS)
entries.reconciliation: Re-proven STILL-LIVE at HEAD 0fef726 in REGRESSION run stable-yield-accumulator-13: in-scope contract src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol blob byte-identical to run-12 baseline 71abe3e (blob d9984cfe). Pure-reasoning finding; STILL-LIVE by byte-identity. Status unchanged.
entries.description: claim() loops registered strategies; previews nest the clients[] loop (L556). As (strategy count x authorized-client count) grows, gas can exceed discount*pending-yield so no rational claimer claims and consolidation stalls (phlimbo stops receiving). econ-scanner CORRECTED the static/pattern permissionless-DoS premise: both growable dimensions are owner-gated (addYieldStrategy onlyOwner) and strategy-owner-gated (setClient owner-gated). Operational footgun, self-correcting (owner raises discount/prunes); exemptStrategies mitigates single-strategy cases. Root cause is SYA's own loop (in-scope; KI#7 does not cover it).
crossLinks: story-024 exemptStrategies: mitigates single-strategy pathologies, not aggregate cardinality.

entries.label: L-06
entries.title: Preview (snapshot estimate) diverges from charged amount (actual skim) with no payment ceiling; getTotalYield ignores per-token pause — no profitable sandwich
entries.reconciliation: Re-proven STILL-LIVE at HEAD 0fef726 in REGRESSION run stable-yield-accumulator-13: in-scope contract src/StableYieldAccumulator.sol blob byte-identical to run-12 baseline 71abe3e (blob d9984cfe). Pure-reasoning finding; STILL-LIVE by byte-identity. Status unchanged.
entries.description: Two SYA-side issues: (a) minRewardTokenSupplied is a FLOOR only with no max-payment ceiling, so the documented two-source preview-vs-actual divergence (story-025) can revert a claimer's own approval (self-DoS, NFT preserved); (b) getTotalYield omits the per-token paused skip that claim()/calculateClaimAmount() apply, over-reporting to integrators. econ-scanner concluded NO profitable sandwich (inflating the victim's actualPayment also gifts them the yield). No protocol value loss; state-handling/view-consistency + UX-slippage. Strategy-side magnitude roots in OOS adapter (KI#7).
crossLinks: L-03 / F-01: same claim()-flow doc-drift family (two-source design documented in story-025); keep distinct.
KI#7: strategy-side divergence magnitude scoped out.

entries.label: QA-01
entries.title: Permissionless first-claimer captures the entire accumulated discount in one shot; minRewardTokenSupplied defaults to 0 (intended incentive + residual MEV note)

entries.description: By-design decentralized-conversion incentive: the first valid-NFT caller captures the whole accumulated discount; the protocol pays exactly discount*yield regardless of WHO claims, so no protocol value leak. Claim-race is ordinary MEV; losers revert ZeroAmount (NFT preserved). Pattern-matcher's nudge winner-take-all is a red herring (proportional owner-set share). Residual in-scope note: minRewardTokenSupplied=0 default disables the per-claim floor (dust/zero-payment edge, cross-ref L-01). Kept visible (Law 1), not dropped as by-design.
crossLinks: L-01: min=0 default exposes the dust/zero-payment edge.
